mapper.insert: insert into ass_qc_expert_eliminate_confirmed (`origin_id`, `expert_uid`, `pro_id`, `task_id`, `reason`, `prev_pro_stat`, `created`, `confirmed_time`) select e.id, e.expert_uid, e.pro_id, e.task_id, e.reason, e.prev_pro_stat, e.created, now() from ass_qc_expert_eliminate e where e.expert_uid = #{expertUid} and e.task_id = #{taskId} and e.deleted = 0
